source.house: AGENT.md v1: YAML frontmatter with name, description, goal, tools and success_criteria (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Start AGENT.md with a first line of exactly '---', write the frontmatter as a 'key: value' mapping (name, description, goal, tools, success_criteria), and close it with a '---' line.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: goal states what the agent must finish, at least 15 characters (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Write the goal the agent must reach as one sentence in goal.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: at least one success criterion an outcome checker recognizes (eva.outcome_evidence until unit B1 types the criteria; no dated record)

rules.fix: Write at least one success criterion a machine can check (for example 'at least 3 source links', 'at most 800 characters', 'a comparison table', 'at least 2 file:line citations', 'read-only'). Keep the criteria that cannot be checked automatically next to them.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: at least two valid scenarios in scenarios/*.json (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Put at least {min} valid JSON scenarios in the scenarios/ folder.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: every scenario follows schemas/scenario.schema.json (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Write each scenario as a JSON object and fill in id (a string), turns ([{"user": ...}]), expected_tools, must_include (lists of strings) and expected_outcome.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: every scenario has an expected_outcome (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Add an expected_outcome to every scenario.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: frontmatter tools lists the tools the agent uses (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Declare the tools the agent uses in the frontmatter tools: list.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: scenario expected_tools are declared in tools (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Declare {undeclared} in tools or remove them from the scenarios.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: a Tools section says when to use each tool (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Add a '## Tools' section that says when to use each tool.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: a memory, handoff or context section (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Write a '## Memory & Handoff' section that says what the agent remembers and how it hands work over.

source.house: AGENT.md v1: at least one scenario with two or more turns (README agent section; no dated record)

rules.fix: Add a scenario with two or more turns whose later turns refer to what an earlier turn said.
